description: What the platform thinks should be reordered: rescans stock against the merchant's auto-reorder rules and returns the suggested orders it left behind, grouped by supplier and outlet. Answers 'what am I running low on', 'what should I order this week'. A suggestion is NOT an order — nothing has been sent and no supplier knows about it. Turn one into a real order with update_purchase_order (which accepts it as a draft) and then send_purchase_order. Only items with an auto-reorder rule can appear here, so an empty result usually means no rules are set rather than nothing being low — say that, and offer set_reorder_rule. The rescan is skipped and the stored suggestions returned when one ran moments ago; `rescanned: false` says so.
name: hub_get_reorder_suggestions
title: What needs reordering
